name: Should I replace or refinish my existing bathtub or shower during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace or refinish my existing bathtub or shower during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to replace or refinish your bathtub or shower depends on its current condition and your budget. Refinishing is a more cost-effective option for tubs that are structurally sound but have cosmetic flaws like stains or dullness. However, if the tub has significant damage, leaks, or you desire a different style or size, replacement is usually the better choice. A new shower enclosure can also significantly modernize the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Refinish a structurally sound tub for cosmetic updates; replace it if damaged, leaking, or if a new style/size is desired.
